title: Create blog post Zod schema for metadata validation
description: Define TypeScript interfaces and Zod validation schema for blog post metadata. Ensures all blog posts have required fields (title, date, slug, featured_image, tags, category) at compile time. Integrates validation into build process to prevent incomplete posts from being deployed.
acceptanceCriteria: BlogPost interface defined in lib/blog-types.ts with required fields: slug, title, date, featured_image, excerpt, tags (array), category, author
Zod schema created in lib/blog-validation.ts; validateBlogPost() function exported and used during build to check all blog data
Build fails with clear error message if any blog post in site/content/blog/*.ts violates schema
technicalNotes: Files to create: lib/blog-types.ts (interfaces), lib/blog-validation.ts (Zod schema and validate function)
Test command: npm run build && npm run test -- lib/blog-validation.ts -v
Integration point: import { validateBlogPost } from 'lib/blog-validation' into build script and validate each getAllBlogPosts() entry

title: Implement /api/blog/posts JSON endpoint for blog discovery
description: Create HTTP API endpoint that returns all blog posts with metadata as JSON. Enables external widgets, search integrations, and RSS generators to discover blog content programmatically. Supports pagination and total count.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/blog/posts returns { posts: BlogPost[], total: number, page: number } with limit=10 default and offset=0 default
Each post object includes: slug, title, date, excerpt, featured_image, category, tags array
Query params: ?limit=20&offset=40 for pagination; response headers include 'Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600' and 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *'
technicalNotes: Files to create: app/api/blog/posts/route.ts (GET handler), lib/get-all-blog-posts.ts (refactored helper)
Fetch from all blog post files in site/content/blog/, sort by date descending, slice by offset and limit

title: Build JB News widget with curated RSS feed integration
description: Create homepage widget that fetches latest articles from curated RSS feeds (tourism boards, local news, travel blogs). Displays 5 most recent items with title, date, source name, and external link. Caches results with 30-minute staleTime.
acceptanceCriteria: JBNewsWidget component renders on home page with 5 latest items from configured RSS sources (Tourism Johor, Malaysia Tourism Board, Backpacker RSS feeds)
Each item displays title, source name, publication date, and external link in new tab; responsive 1-column mobile, 5-item row desktop
Results cached via React Query with 30-minute staleTime; graceful error handling shows fallback message if fetch fails
technicalNotes: Files to create: components/JBNewsWidget.tsx (React component), lib/fetch-news-feeds.ts (fetch helper), lib/news-feed-sources.ts (RSS URLs config)
Test command: npm run test -- components/JBNewsWidget.tsx -v
Parse RSS using xml2js or DOMParser; use native fetch() in server component or async component. Install: npm install xml2js

title: Create related blog posts suggestion component with tag-based matching
description: Build React component that displays 3–4 blog posts related to the current article, matched by shared tags and category. Rendered at end of blog article. Uses tag overlap scoring to rank relevance.
acceptanceCriteria: RelatedBlogPosts component accepts currentPostSlug prop and displays 3–4 related posts sorted by number of shared tags (descending); excludes current post from results
Each suggestion shows post title, publication date, featured_image thumbnail (200×150 px), and clickable link to /blog/[slug]
Component renders as Tailwind grid: 4 columns on desktop, 2 columns on tablet, 1 column on mobile
technicalNotes: Files to create: components/RelatedBlogPosts.tsx (Client Component), lib/find-similar-posts.ts (scoring function)
Test command: npm run test -- components/RelatedBlogPosts.tsx lib/find-similar-posts.ts -v
findSimilarPosts(currentSlug, allBlogPosts, limit=4) returns array of posts ranked by tag.filter(t => currentPost.tags.includes(t)).length descending

title: Extend RSS feed with image enclosure support for blog posts
description: Modify RSS feed generation to include <enclosure> element for each blog post's featured_image. Enables RSS readers to display post thumbnails inline. Validates enclosure URLs resolve and sets correct MIME types.
acceptanceCriteria: Each <item> in RSS feed includes <enclosure url='featured_image_url' length='bytes' type='image/jpeg|image/png|image/webp' /> element
Enclosure length fetched via HEAD request to featured_image URL; MIME type determined by file extension (.jpg→image/jpeg, .png→image/png, .webp→image/webp)
Feed validates against RSS 2.0 schema using RSS validator; all enclosure URLs must return HTTP 200
technicalNotes: Files to modify: app/api/blog/feed.xml/route.ts (add enclosure generation), create lib/rss-enclosure.ts (helper for MIME type and size)
For each blog post, call getImageMimeType(featured_image) and await getImageContentLength(featured_image) before adding <enclosure/> to RSS item
